# JavaScript and Sass reference index

Derived from the documentation catalogue's `exports` and `styles` ownership. Use bundled contracts at the resolved version; public website links require matching version evidence.

Contents: [JavaScript exports](#javascript-exports), [Sass functions and mixins](#sass-functions-and-mixins), [Sass partials](#sass-partials).

## JavaScript exports

Import names from `@expressivecss/expressive`, or from `@expressivecss/expressive/modular` when the application owns shared initialization. `AutoInit` initializes registry descendants; `version` reports the framework version. Per-element components inherit `init`, `getInstance` and `destroy`; shared behaviors follow their own contracts.

## Sass functions and mixins

The [Sass API](https://www.expressivecss.com/sass.html.md) documents package-importer setup, configuration and all shared functions and mixins. Use [Install](../expressivecss-install/SKILL.md#sass) for the public entry and selective builds. Prefer component markup before using lower-level component mixins.
